sentences.text: Lisbon -LRB- -LSB- ˈlɪzbən -RSB- Lisboa , -LSB- liʒˈβoɐ -RSB- -RRB- is the capital and the largest city of Portugal , with a population of 552,700 within its administrative limits in an area of 100.05 km ² .	Portugal	Portugal	Lisbon	Lisbon (district)

Its urban area extends beyond the city 's administrative limits with a population of around 2.7 million people , being the 11th-most populous urban area in the European Union .	urban area	urban area	11th-most populous urban area	Largest urban areas of the European Union	European Union	European Union

About 2.8 million people live in the Lisbon Metropolitan Area -LRB- which represents approximately 27 % of the country 's population -RRB- .	Lisbon Metropolitan Area	Lisbon Metropolitan Area	Lisbon	Lisbon (district)
It is continental Europe 's westernmost capital city and the only one along the Atlantic coast .	Europe	Europe
Lisbon lies in the western Iberian Peninsula on the Atlantic Ocean and the River Tagus .	Tagus	Tagus	Lisbon	Lisbon (district)	Iberian Peninsula	Iberian Peninsula	Atlantic Ocean	Atlantic Ocean
The westernmost areas of its metro area is the westernmost point of Continental Europe .	Europe	Europe	Continental Europe	Continental Europe

Lisbon is recognised as a global city because of its importance in finance , commerce , media , entertainment , arts , international trade , education and tourism .	Lisbon	Lisbon (district)	global city	global city	media	Publishing	arts	The arts	international trade	international trade
It is one of the major economic centres on the continent , with a growing financial sector and one of the largest container ports on Europe 's Atlantic coast .	Europe	Europe

Humberto Delgado Airport serves over 20 million passengers annually , as of 2015 , and the motorway network and the high-speed rail system of Alfa Pendular link the main cities of Portugal .	Portugal	Portugal	Humberto Delgado Airport	Lisbon Airport	motorway network	Auto-estrada	high-speed rail	high-speed rail	Alfa Pendular	Alfa Pendular

The city is the 7th-most-visited city in Southern Europe , after Istanbul , Rome , Barcelona , Madrid , Athens and Milan , with 1,740,000 tourists in 2009 .	Europe	Europe	Southern Europe	Southern Europe	Istanbul	Istanbul	Rome	Rome	Barcelona	Barcelona	Madrid	Madrid	Athens	Athens	Milan	Milan

The Lisbon region contributes with a higher GDP PPP per capita than any other region in Portugal .	Portugal	Portugal	Lisbon	Lisbon (district)	Lisbon region	Lisbon region	higher GDP PPP per capita	Economy of the European Union#Richest & Poorest NUTS Regions (GDP PPP 2007)	region	NUTS II
It 's GDP amounts to 96.3 billion USD and thus $ 32,434 per capita , 40 % higher than the average European Union 's GDP per capita .	European Union	European Union
The city occupies 32nd place of highest gross earnings in the world .
Most of the headquarters of multinationals in the country are located in the Lisbon area .	Lisbon	Lisbon (district)
It is also the political centre of the country , as its seat of Government and residence of the Head of State .	Government	Government of Portugal	Head of State	President of Portugal

Lisbon is one of the oldest cities in the world , and the oldest in Western Europe , predating other modern European capitals such as London , Paris and Rome by centuries .	Lisbon	Lisbon (district)	Europe	Europe	Rome	Rome	oldest cities in the world	List of oldest continuously inhabited cities	Western Europe	Western Europe	London	London	Paris	Paris
Julius Caesar made it a municipium called Felicitas Julia , adding to the name Olissipo .	Julius Caesar	Julius Caesar	municipium	municipium	Olissipo	Olisipo
Ruled by a series of Germanic tribes from the 5th century , it was captured by the Moors in the 8th century .	Germanic tribes	Germanic peoples	Moors	Moors

In 1147 , the Crusaders under Afonso Henriques reconquered the city and since then it has been a major political , economic and cultural centre of Portugal .	Portugal	Portugal	Crusaders	Second Crusade	Afonso Henriques	Afonso Henriques	reconquered the city	Siege of Lisbon

Unlike most capital cities , Lisbon 's status as the capital of Portugal has never been granted or confirmed officially -- by statute or in written form .	Portugal	Portugal	Lisbon	Lisbon (district)	statute	statute

Its position as the capital has formed through constitutional convention , making its position as de facto capital a part of the Constitution of Portugal .	Portugal	Portugal	constitutional convention	constitutional convention (political custom)	Constitution of Portugal	Constitution of Portugal
Lisbon enjoys a Mediterranean climate .	Lisbon	Lisbon (district)	Mediterranean climate	Mediterranean climate
It has one of the warmest winters of any metropolis in Europe , with average temperatures 15 ° C during the day and 8 ° C at night from December to February .	Europe	Europe
The typical summer season lasts about four months , from June to September , although also in April temperatures sometimes reach around 25 ° C.
